title: Upgrade from supported prior installation while preserving state
journey: Represent source version, commit, schema version, install type and artifact identity. v0.1.0 commit fa23232ff0154f627ebdd221ec5435134f177af0 is representable; unknown/newer schema fails closed; no rollback claim for irreversible migrations.

platform.desktop_session: required for graphical desktop journeys; otherwise not applicable

preconditions: Disposable dedicated acceptance identity and scenario-owned state.
No prior Synveil installation, package registration, installer-owned integration or stale acceptance state unless a declared upgrade/recovery source is required.
A brand-new OS and removal of unrelated user files are not required.

Seed dedicated scenario-owned application config, credential presence/identity, client sync state, non-empty library and server config/database/object records where applicable; capture logical snapshots before the lifecycle operation.
Record an explicit disabled startup preference before upgrade; assert it remains disabled after platform integration reconciliation.

artifact_requirements.artifact_type: upgrade artifact plus supported source installation

steps.description: Upgrade from a declared supported source installation.
Launch through the supported installed entrypoint.

assertions.description: Installed application reaches the declared target product version.
Upgraded application passes health and launch checks after guarded compatible migration.
Supported installed entrypoint launches after upgrade.
Unknown or newer source schema stops safely without reset or downgrade.
An explicitly disabled current-user startup registration remains disabled after upgrade.

forbidden_outcomes.description: Installer lifecycle deletes user library content.
Credential value is written to ordinary config or diagnostics.
Unknown or newer schema is reset or downgraded.
Persistent startup is enabled without explicit user consent.
Desktop control is exposed through a public TCP/HTTP listener.
An ambiguous mutation is blindly replayed without authoritative reconciliation.
Installation is reported complete before payload, integration and launch verification.
